SELECT ts_doy, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_temp_c, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32), 1) as avg_temp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 237
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat,
       SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 213 AND fish_date_doy < 244 AND cls = 'overnight'
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat,
       SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / (SUM(anglers) + COUNT(*) * 5), 2) as est_share
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as boats, ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as avg_yt
FROM trips
WHERE (fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy >= 287) OR (fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 287)
GROUP BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_season, fish_date_doy
LIMIT 30
